notes: Vodalian Arcanist, printed: '{T}: Add {C}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell.' Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). With {B} in the pool, Walking Corpse ({1}{B}, a creature spell) cannot use the Arcanist's {C}, so the payer finds no payment: the cast is refused, Walking Corpse stays in hand and the Arcanist stays untapped.
